What to do by hand:
- B04 and B14: the form wants Day/Month/Year. If your passport prints these dates another way, rewrite them in that order, e.g. as DD/MM/YYYY.
- B05: the form has separate City, State or Province, and Country boxes. Split your place of birth across them.
- B27: I put your number under both Tel. and Mobile No. If it is a landline, leave Mobile No. blank. If it is a mobile and you have no landline, you can leave Tel. blank.
- B11: I ticked Ordinary, the usual type for a tourist passport. Change it if yours is diplomatic or official.
- B33/B34: I wrote "None" because you didn't mention anyone in Japan guaranteeing or inviting you. If someone is, tell me and I'll fill these in.
- B25: if you remember the exact dates of the October 2023 stay, add them, e.g. "DD/10/2023 to DD/10/2023 (9 days)".
- B35 is optional. Remove it if you prefer.

Important for your daughter: her passport is valid only until 1 January 2027, which is before you arrive on 20 April 2027. She will need a new passport before she can apply for her visa. Also, Japan usually expects a passport to stay valid for the whole stay.
